fields.description: Issue reports on Miami municipal affairs, including City Clerk Harold E. Ross’s statement that an audit will show an approximately $12,000 shortage attributed to unpaid municipal court fines and bail-bond practices, and commentary on court procedures and professional bondsmen. It also covers efforts to prosecute marble board gambling devices, includes local columns and opinion pieces, nightlife and entertainment items, advertisements, and sports coverage (including fishing and baseball notes).
